about: Every generated 3D asset of the clay art direction, from the design doc's Art Inspiration tab (Costumes, Props and backdrops, The stage) and its Stories tab. Tools/art_gen.py reads it and fills in the status fields (images, pick, ref, task, credits, fbx). See Docs/PropArt.md.
style_suffix: Made of modeling clay in a stop-motion claymation style. Matte clay surface with faint thumbprints, saturated slightly chalky colors, soft even lighting. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object centered and in frame, plain light gray background. A single object, no text, no people.
negative: blood, gore, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, people, hands, multiple objects, cropped, cut off, busy background, strong shadows, photorealistic, glossy plastic
